name: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance
description: Core financial management system used for general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, budgeting, fixed assets and financial reporting.

name: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales
description: Customer relationship management platform used to manage leads, opportunities, customer accounts, quotations and sales orders.

name: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management
description: Supply chain platform covering procurement, inventory management, warehouse operations, demand planning and logistics.

name: Employee Management System
description: Human resource information system used for employee records, leave management, payroll data, performance management and onboarding workflows.

name: Identity and Access Management System
description: Centralized identity provider used for user authentication, single sign-on, multi-factor authentication and access provisioning across enterprise systems.

name: IT Service Desk
description: IT service management platform used to log, track and resolve employee IT support tickets, incidents and service requests.

name: Enterprise Document Management System
description: Central repository for corporate policies, contracts, compliance records and departmental documentation with version control and access permissions.
